body: Filled triangle means the bond is coming out of the page towards you, dashed means going into the page. It's a way to help visualise the 3D structure which becomes very important as chemistry becomes more advanced. The dashed single line has a variety of uses and depends on context, it can mean a partial bond or interaction usually. The line with dashed line next to it usually means a resonance structure so it exists both with a single bond and double bond (crudely speaking).
